description: Get upcoming investor-relations events for a stock — earnings webcasts, conference appearances, presentations, and shareholder meetings — scraped from the company's IR website. Returns events scheduled from now onward, soonest first, optionally filtered by event type. Coverage is partial — an empty answer distinguishes a coverage gap from a genuinely empty calendar. Only future events are returned; for past events and their transcripts use ListInvestorEvents / GetInvestorEventTranscript.

eventType.description: Optional event-type filter: EarningsCall, Conference, Presentation, ShareholderMeeting, or Webcast. Omit for all types. Events whose source label could not be classified carry the generic type 'Event' and only appear when no filter is set.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 20, max: 500)

name: GetUpcomingInvestorEvents
title: Upcoming Investor Events
